Decision Impact

The scheduled-loop evidence is sufficient for RC review and for proving the schedule wiring works. It is also part of the reference exemplar publication packet. Adopters should assign owners, retention expectations, escalation paths, and any longer soak window before operating the loop as a local control. The refreshed 2026-05-25 service-owned custody evidence covers the Calabi demonstration path.
